_comment: Drivers confirmed to keep exited processes in kernel memory. Add yours via a pull request or an issue (zombieprobe.ps1 report). 'versions' = file versions where the leak was confirmed.

culprits.device: AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (Ryzen integrated GPU, not driving a monitor)
culprits.evidence: probe 50/50 zombies; device disabled at runtime -> 0/50; zombie count flat afterwards (was +575/min); stable for 2 weeks after the fix
culprits.fix: Disable the unused iGPU in Device Manager (or in BIOS), or update the AMD graphics driver and re-run the test.
